**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 3 (the ladders, area by area): 20 of 22 areas have a ladder.** `bun nv scaling` in `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts` measures five kinds (`run`, `compile`, `lsp`, `fmt`, `serve`); its module doc is the home of the ramp, the bounds, `KINDS`, `AREAS` and the `serve` sizes (`SERVE_SIZES`, `serveShape`). Tests: `tools/nv/test/scaling.test.ts`.

**`--areas` still names two:** `http-client` and `app`. The `request` and `connections` ladders are written and flat (`request/headers`, `request/header-bytes`, `request/body`, `request/query`, `connections/open`).

**Ladders that grow:** `fmt/classes.nvs`, `lsp/classes.nvs`, and `numbers/bigint-mul.nvs` (allocations at slope 1.85, clock follows Toom-3; under *Benches to look at*). Every other ladder is flat. `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` *What we found* has the 1.05 MB per `Core\Task`, a POST body the program does not read losing its response at 16 KB and over, and requests with more than about 100 headers not being answered on a kept-alive connection. None of their causes is checked.

**`lsp` callgrind** (`lspInstructions`) has not run. **`--iterations --check`** has had no full sweep since benches that settle on counts started going to callgrind. `docs/perf/performance-review.md` does not exist yet (Stage 4).

items.text: **An `http-client` ladder**: response size under `Core\Http`. The program needs a server to fetch from, so the tool boots one: a `run` ladder whose program fetches a local `nvs serve` of a fixture that answers `size` bytes, or a new `size` for `serve` where the client is the ladder. Pick the one that keeps `MEASURES` at `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:692` simplest, and write the size into the module doc. Then add `benches/scaling/http-client/<name>.nvs`. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.

**The `app` ladder**: the small shop the goal prose describes under Stage 3, at `benches/scaling/app/`, run over rows per page and requests served. `serveShape` at `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:621` shapes the load. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.

**Check the two server findings** written under *What we found* in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md`, with `curl` against `nvs serve`: the unread POST body and the header count. The serve loop is `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs:6746`. Rule: `rule:http-server/request-body-and-upload-total-are-two-caps`.
